snippet.title: Longplay of Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar
snippet.description:
Longplay of Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar, played as the PAL version on the Master System. This game's version was released in 1990. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!

00:00:00 - Opening
00:01:40 - New Game/Character Creation

Collecting Runes & Mantras
00:09:10 - Moonglow - Rune of Honesty & Mantra
00:18:00 - *Cheating blind woman selling reagents to mix all spells I'll need for the rest of the game*
00:35:19 - Waiting for a Moongate (mostly cut in the future instances)
00:39:47 - Britannia - learing about the Quest of the Avatar
00:43:41 - *Stealing treasures*
00:52:43 - Britain - Rune of Compassion & Mantra/ Iolo joined
01:03:12 - *Grinding levels by attacking town guards*
01:07:10 - Waiting for a Pirate Ship to spawn (mostly cut in the future instances)
01:08:50 - Buccaneer's Den - Magic Wand (best weapon for mage, druid & bard) & Sextant
01:16:22 - *Stealing more money offscreen and buying 2 more wands*
01:20:34 - Paws - Horse
01:28:56 - Trinsic - Mantra of Honor (forgot the rune this time)
01:33:26 - Magincia - Mantra of Humility & info on Rune
01:46:44 - Skara Brae - Mantra of Spirituality & info on Rune/ Shamino joined
01:58:11 - Jhelom - Rune of Valor & Mantra
02:14:41 - Epath Abbey - Info
02:24:11 - Yew - Rune of Justice & Mantra
02:33:04 - Britannia - Rune of Spirituality
02:38:03 - Minoc - Rune of Sacrifice & Mantra/ Julia joined/Magic Axe (best weapon for palladin & tinker)
02:52:01 - Paws - Rune of Huimility
02:53:56 - Wheel of the H.M.S
02:55:43 - Silver Horn
02:57:56 - Buccaneer's Den - Magic Bow (best weapon for ranger)
03:00:27 - Bell of Courage
03:02:10 - Vespar - Info

Grinding virtues & going to shrines
03:08:05 - Shrine of Humility
03:11:00 - Skull of Mondain the Wizard (wait for 2 new moons and search)
03:18:00 - Tossing the Skull into the Abyss (grants boost in all virtues)
03:21:18 - Grinding Sacrifice - Donate blood to a healer, go to Lord British for free heals and repeat
03:26:00 - Shrine of Sacrifice
03:29:00 - Grinding Honesty, Justice & Honor - Overpay the blind reagents saleswoman for 1 reagent, wait 16 turns and repeat
03:34:25 - Trinsic - Rune of Honor (forgot to get it on the first visit)
03:36:58 - Shrine of Honor
03:41:07 - Shrine of Justice
03:43:20 - Yew - Jaana joined
03:46:26 - Shrine of Honesty
03:50:00 - Grinding Compassion - Give a beggar 1 gold, wait 16 turns, repeat
03:51:53 - Grinding Spirituality - Talk to Hawkwind the Seer, wait 16 turns, repeat
03:54:03 - Shrine of Compassion
03:56:48 - Shrine of Spirituality - Go through Minoc Moongate at 2 full moons
03:57:49 - Grinding Valor - Fight evil creatures and avoid killing non-evil creatures
03:59:00 - Minoc - second Magic Axe
04:03:11 - Jhelom - Geoffrey joined
04:03:56 - Shrine of Valor/ 8 part avatarhood obtained

Preparing for Dungeons
04:06:02 - Trinsic - Dupre joined
04:12:54 - Serpent's Hold - Mystic Swords X8 (sells for allot of money and can be picked up again once sold, otherwise useless)
04:19:28 - Epath Abbey - Mystic Armour X8 (best armour for any class)
04:23:25 - Cove - Candle of Love
04:33:36 - Lycaeum - Book of Truth
04:46:12 - Buccaneer's Den - Shopping

Dungeons
04:55:36 - Castle Britania - Getting into Dungeon Hythloth
04:57:02 - Dungeon Hythloth - Baloon
05:33:34 - Getting the White Stone using Baloon
05:46:37 - Dungeon Destard from the top - Red Stone
06:02:53 - Dungeon Shame from the altar - Purple Stone
06:59:09 - Magincia - Katrina joined
07:05:20 - Dungeon Wrong from the top - Green Stone
08:08:13 - Dungeon Covetous from the altar - Orange Stone
08:44:52 - Dungeon Despise from the top - Yellow Stone
09:15:53 - Altar of Love - First Three Part Key 
09:21:47 - Dungeon Deceit from the top - Blue Stone
09:36:23 - Altar of Love - Second Three Part Key
09:41:24 - Dungeon Destard from the top - Backtracking to the Altar
09:43:29 - Altar of Courage - Third Three Part Key

Final dungeon preparation:
09:48:21 - Black Stone - Search Moonglow Moongate at 2 new moons
09:52:54 - Skara Brae - Word of Passage 1/6
09:56:23 - Paws - Word of Passage 2/6
09:59:00 - Cove - Word of Passage 3/6
10:02:01 - Lycaeum - Word of Passage 4/6
10:04:09 - Serpent's Hold - Word of Passage 5/6
10:06:37 - Epath Abbey - Word of Passage 6/6
10:11:38 - Opening the Great Stigian Abyss - Bell of Courage, Book of Truth and Candle of Love
10:12:10 - Dungeon the Great Stygian Abyss
11:33:36 - Final Boss
11:40:15 - Test of Virtues
11:44:00 - Ending

By: nikodem123asdf
